description: This file contains test utilities, templates, and helper functions for testing and benchmarking the absl::container::btree data structures, including key generation, type traits, and test data generation.

classes.name: remove_pair_const
classes.description: Type trait to remove const qualifiers from types, propagating through std::pair.

classes.name: KeyOfValue
classes.description: Template struct to extract key from a value, with specialization for set types.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: Template struct to generate test values of various types, specialized for absl::Time, std::string, Cord, and std::pair.

methods.name: GenerateDigits
methods.description: Generates a string representation of a number in a custom base.

methods.name: GenerateNumbersWithSeed
methods.description: Generates a vector of unique integers within a range, using a seed for reproducibility.

methods.name: GenerateValuesWithSeed
methods.description: Generates a vector of values of type V, based on generated numbers and a seed.
